trust_decision.summary: A downloaded seed wheel is trusted to be the PyPI release its filename names: at the pinned commit nothing decides this - download_wheel trusts pip's exit code and the filename it parsed - while the fix decides it in download_wheel (acquire.py) by sha256 against PyPI's JSON release record via verify_wheel_digest in periodic_update.py, and declines to decide at all when PIP_INDEX_URL/PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL/PIP_INDEX is set.

landing_point.why: download_wheel is the only place virtualenv fetches a seed wheel with `pip download`; a reader of the summary 'downloaded seed wheels are not integrity-checked' lands on this function and on its return at acquire.py:140-142, where the wheel is handed back unexamined.

fix_sites.entry_point: virtualenv CLI environment creation with seeding (FromAppData._get_seed_wheels -> get_wheel(download=True)) and the public virtualenv.seed.wheels.get_wheel(download=True) API
same download_wheel callers; the gate reads the caller's env (os.environ via Seeder.env), i.e. virtualenv CLI env creation and --upgrade-embed-wheels
fix_sites.module_kind: module-level defaults/gate in the acquisition module

fix_sites.entry_point: virtualenv --upgrade-embed-wheels (manual_upgrade -> do_update -> download_wheel) and the background periodic updater (trigger_update -> do_update)
fix_sites.module_kind: verification helper in the periodic-update / PyPI-metadata module

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/virtualenv/seed/wheels/periodic_update.py:382-405 (_pypi_get_distribution_info_cached / _pypi_get_distribution_info) - the digest check lands in the periodic-update module and has to reach the private cached PyPI JSON loader, one module away from the download sink

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A wheel the periodic updater replays from the app-data update log was already hashed when download_wheel fetched it, so checking it again on reload is redundant.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A custom/private pip index (or an offline mirror) legitimately serves a rebuilt wheel under the same distribution, version and filename PyPI also uses; a blanket 'hash must equal PyPI's digest' check rejects a wheel that came from exactly the configured source. The caller's env is forwarded straight into the pip subprocess, so this is a supported configuration.

O6_input_shapes: wheel path parsed from pip stdout marker 'Saved ' (src/virtualenv/seed/wheels/acquire.py:148-152)
wheel path parsed from marker 'File was already downloaded ' (a file already sitting in the house) (src/virtualenv/seed/wheels/acquire.py:150)
no marker at all: fall back to any compatible wheel already in the target folder (src/virtualenv/seed/wheels/acquire.py:153-154, 157-172)
no wheel identified anywhere -> RuntimeError instead of an AttributeError (fix.diff:75-77)
distribution or version absent from PyPI's 'releases' map -> not verifiable, let through (fix.diff:113-116, 128-134)
release present but the exact filename not among its files -> let through (fix.diff:134)
release file entry with no sha256 digest -> let through (fix.diff:117-121)
PyPI lookup fails (offline / URLError) -> let through (fix.diff:388-405 path via _pypi_get_distribution_info)
custom index configured through PIP_INDEX_URL, PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL or PIP_INDEX -> whole check skipped (fix.diff:41-45)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The periodic updater replays a wheel from the persisted embed update log (Wheel(app_data.house / filename)) and seeds it without ever re-reading its bytes; the project's own test asserts the second get_wheel call reuses the cached wheel without downloading.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Those wheels were hashed when download_wheel fetched them, so the reload path needs no second check.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (seed/wheels), one module over from acquire.py; state crosses the app-data JSON store at src/virtualenv/app_data/via_disk_folder.py:104-105 and is exercised by tests/unit/seed/wheels/test_acquire.py:135-159

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Wheels supplied through --extra-search-dir are accepted by from_dir and seeded without any digest check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The user pointed virtualenv at that directory, so its contents are the user's own trust decision.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the landing point (seed/wheels/bundle.py, one file)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Seeding installs from a cached extracted wheel image keyed only by the wheel file stem; when an image exists it is reused without looking at the wheel file again.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The image was built from a wheel that had already passed the download check.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: two packages away: seed/wheels -> seed/embed/via_app_data, with the reuse test at src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/pip_install/base.py:219-220 and src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/via_app_data.py:156-160

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The PipInvoke seeder installs into the target venv with `pip install --find-links <folder> <dist>==<version>` and only passes --no-index when downloads are disabled, so pip may resolve the requirement itself.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The requirement is version-pinned and the matching wheel is already in the --find-links folder, so pip never needs an index.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Digest-verify a wheel taken from --extra-search-dir against PyPI when its filename matches a published release.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same shape as download_wheel: a wheel arriving from outside the bundle, keyed by distribution/version/for_py_version, and the module already has discover_wheels to name the candidate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Verify the copied embed wheel after copy2 into app_data.house, or verify the house copy before it is replayed.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The maintainer already owns this file and already copies a wheel into the house here; a second entry into the same directory is a natural place for the same check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Key the cached wheel image on a digest of the wheel rather than its stem, or re-verify the wheel when the image is reused.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The cache key already names the installer class and the wheel stem; extending it with a hash is a small, natural change and the reuse branch is right there at line 70.

O9_family: download of code without integrity check (CWE-494), supply-chain/artifact integrity

O10_build.toolchain: hatchling + hatch-vcs build backend; pytest/tox for tests; no compiled extensions
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/seed/wheels/test_acquire.py (mocks acquire.Popen), tests/unit/seed/wheels/test_periodic_update.py (mocks urlopen), tests/unit/seed/wheels/test_bundle.py (bundled-wheel sha256 checks), tests/unit/seed/embed/test_bootstrap_link_via_app_data.py and test_pip_invoke.py; the live path needs PyPI, but every existing test mocks the subprocess and the JSON fetch, so the suite runs offline.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Compare the wheel's sha256 with a digest fetched from PyPI inside download_wheel only, then verify by re-running that one path and stop.

out_of_scope_notes: Other hardening already in this tree (zip-slip guard at src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/pip_install/base.py:26-41, activation argument quoting) belongs to different advisories and was not assessed.
Limitation documented in the fix itself: a pip.conf/PIP_CONFIG_FILE index redirect is invisible to the index gate (fix.diff:34-40); noted as a fix-internal limit, not pursued as an additional route.
unverified: Repository size in MB could not be measured (no shell available); the src tree is about 106 files including four bundled wheels, so the tiny_repo threshold was not decided and the flag is left off.
No latest release or latest tree was provided ('none'), so present_in_latest for every O8 route is unknown.
Whether any hidden test exercises a real PyPI round trip: tests here mock urlopen, so the affected behaviour was not executed and no code was run.
